message.content: {"note_claim": "US 2025 strikes (Operation Midnight Hammer) obliterated Iran's nuclear facilities at Natanz, Fordow, and Isfahan, per White House.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Dan “Razin” Caine : “Initial battle damage assessments indicate that all three sites sustained extremely severe damage and destruction.", "reason": "The White House release asserts the strikes 'obliterated' Iran's nuclear facilities and discusses damage at Fordow, Natanz, and Esfahan, substantiating the claim as attributed to the White House."}

parsed.note_claim: US 2025 strikes (Operation Midnight Hammer) obliterated Iran's nuclear facilities at Natanz, Fordow, and Isfahan, per White House.
